subject: Using Lavaan to estimate factor scores of an EFA solution found in another package

messages.author: 9065d041a7201790
messages.subject: Using Lavaan to estimate factor scores of an EFA solution found in another package
parts:
Dear all.

I am using EFA on ordinal variables in psych with polychoric correlations. I want to estimate factor scores using EBM, as done in lavaan in such cases (and is unavailable in psych or other EFA packages). Is it possible to simply build a CFA model in lavaan while fixing all loadings to the ones found in the EFA and then use lavPredict? Or do I need to fix something else to make the CFA model as close as possible to the original EFA solution?

best,
Isaac

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Using Lavaan to estimate factor scores of an EFA solution found in another package
parts:
I think you would find the answer quickly if you simply tried it yourself.  But fixing the parameters to estimated values would reduce the estimated SE of the factor scores, making it even more problematic to use factor scores as data in a subsequent analysis.  Not sure why you wouldn't simply estimate the FA model again in lavaan.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
